name: The Velvet Hours
heroText: Warm analog pop for late nights and slow mornings. New album “Golden Static” out now.
about: The Velvet Hours is a pop trio blending vintage warmth with modern hooks — think velvet curtains, dusty vinyl and a chorus you can’t forget. Formed in 2021, the band has released two EPs and toured across Europe, earning a reputation for intimate, candle-lit live shows.
